crop.notes: Clothing ad and the full Amusements column; only the Theatre Comique paragraph mentions Allen.

ocr.notes: Readable; minor errors in the ad prices.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported a packed house at the Theatre Comique for a sparring match between Tom Allen and Tom Kelley, with a Bauer-Christol wrestling bout and Hermann's sleight of hand.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Dispatch, Saturday Evening, May 6, 1876 (pre-1878 Dispatch). Sparring was 'last night' (May 5). Same page as 555.

facts.fact: Allen sparred Tom Kelly at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis, before a packed house

notes: Paper spells the name 'Kelley'; 553 and 555 use 'Kelly'.
